subject: general
question: Which organisation, established by the Indian government, serves as the regulatory and promotional body to facilitate increased private sector participation in India's space activities as of March 2025?

options.text: Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre (IN-SPACe)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IN-SPACe** was established by the **Government of India** to act as a regulatory and promotional body for private sector participation in **India's space activities**.
 
• It was announced by the Indian government in **June 2020** as part of reforms to open up the space sector to private players.
 
• IN-SPACe operates under the aegis of the **Department of Space (DoS)** and facilitates non-governmental entities in their engagement with space activities.
 
• The organization ensures the level playing field for private industries, universities, and startups to conduct space-related operations alongside the Indian Space Research Organisation (**ISRO**).
 
• Its primary role includes **authorization, promotion, and hand-holding of private sector entities** in space exploration, satellite development, and launch vehicle creation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO):**

 
 
• ISRO is India's national space agency headquartered in **Bengaluru** and operates under the **Department of Space**.
 
• It was established in **1969** and is responsible for space exploration, satellite deployment, and development of launch vehicles.
 
• Key achievements include the **Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission)**, **Chandrayaan missions**, and the **PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle)**.
 
 
 
• **Department of Space (DoS):**
 
 
• The DoS oversees the space program in India and formulates policies related to space activities.
 
• It manages the coordination between various space organizations, including **ISRO** and **IN-SPACe**.
 
 
 
• **Space Applications Centre (SAC):**
 
 
• SAC is a major center of ISRO located in **Ahmedabad**, Gujarat.
 
• It specializes in the development of payloads for satellites and conducts research in areas such as communication, remote sensing, and space sciences.
 
 
 
• **Role of IN-SPACe:**
 
 
• IN-SPACe acts as a single-window mechanism to allow **private entities** to use ISRO’s facilities and technical expertise.
 
• It provides technical guidance and facilitates the sharing of infrastructure for satellite launches and manufacturing.
 
• It also ensures compliance with national security and international obligations while promoting private sector growth.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Space Sector Reforms in India:**

 
 
• In **2020**, the Government of India introduced reforms to encourage private sector participation in space activities.
 
• These reforms aim to develop a robust ecosystem for space technologies and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of IN-SPACe:**
 
 
• IN-SPACe functions as a bridge between **ISRO** and private companies, ensuring equitable access to space resources.
 
• It plays a crucial role in advancing India’s space exploration goals and developing indigenous capabilities for global competitiveness.
